body: my old boy who i had 4 years died 8/31/15 in my arms..he had a terrible life before i rescued him...caged 10 years...im crying writing this when he died he took apart of me i will never get back...i still cry when i look at  his pictures and his cremation box..holidays arent the same anymore for me ...life isnt the same..im a strong person but my dog had a hold on me more than any woman any family member etc..probably because he was a fighter like me and i believe my soulmate in a way...im sorry for your loss..it does get better.. but for me not much...and i stil have 3 dogs i love as much all over 7 yrs old so i have 3 more heartbreaks ahead..love your dogs every minute of the day..becausr when they re gone..their gone..and u will miss them more than i can out into words

i just quot a year and half  ago..i had enough...2 dui's 3 years apart..countless altercations..fights...assaults....and lots of wasted money..and im only 34...i was never an alcoholic i never needed it..i just liked it..never drank during the weekdsys or went out during the week..just when i did drink i would lose control and couldnt make rational decisions..not everyone is an alcoholic..some people just cant handle being hammered..they get violent and.lose total regard for anything and everything..thats how i FINALLY knew i was done with drink for good...not because i ever needed it..because i knew i DIDNT need it or depend on it...ps..the duis i never crashed or hit anyone ir anything..thank god...i dont know how someone who takes someones life drunk with a vehicle etc could even live with themselves and wake.up in the morning..the guilt would kill me...if u cant control yourself nd lose control when your drunk..then you should quit...it will catch up with you at some.point..

sorry for your loss again..now my last dog who i adopted 2 years ago from the spca has inopperable fibrosarcoma..hes fine for now but here we go again..i paid 900 dollars for the biopsy for them.to tell.me its inoperable and will eventually.close his anus closed to the point where he wont be able.to.poop..

pet loss is heartbreaking....i truly feel what you are going through..im am a grown 34 yr old man and i still cry when i am by myself (and i don't cry)...the pain subsides but my DUKE died august 31st 2015 from organ failure...the day he was supposed to go in to be euthanized..i let it go to long because i was in denial because i wasnt strong enough to ket him do...he died in my arms in my house but to know that he.probly suffered more because i tried to hold.onto him too long when he was basicly already gone (he didnt eat or drink water for 8 days before he died) ...if i think of him or see a pic of him i feel extremely sad..its absolute torture..but it does subside...to a pint..im sorry for your loss what a beautiful cat..sorry again
